> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

2.2.3 Boolean
If the RDL format specifies an element or attribute as type Boolean, it MUST be a valid Boolean
value, as specified in [XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2 for xsd:Boolean.
